name: The Silver Lining
source:
Silver Lining is a game set in a fictionalized version of 1940s America which will tell a story of a young refugee girl and her family fleeing the great war who gets entangled in a web of intrigue while trying to make ends meets in a completly foreign country. Love and heartbreak are guranteed, will your ending be sweet or bittersweet is up to you!

[From [url=https://www.patreon.com/bluedahilagames]Patreon[/url]]
translation:
《乌云背后的幸福线》是一款以20世纪40年代美国的虚构版本为背景的游戏，讲述了一名年轻的难民女孩和她的家人逃离大战的故事，她们在一个完全陌生的国家试图维持生计，却陷入了阴谋的网络中。爱和心碎都是有保证的，你的结局是甜​​蜜还是苦乐参半，取决于你！

[来自[url=https://www.patreon.com/bluedahilagames]Patreon[/url]]
